title: 开业 Opening day
twist: Only one dish. Learn 碗 and the numbers 1–5.

vip.name: 王老师 (Teacher Wang)
vip.situation: Your old teacher orders for the whole class and wants to know the total.

turns.en: Boss, five bowls of beef noodles.

title: 卖完了 Sold out
twist: A dish sells out. First 如果…就… rule: check 有 before you cook.

vip.name: 李奶奶 (Grandma Li)
vip.situation: Grandma Li wants egg noodles, which are sold out. Suggest something else.

turns.en: Boss, do you have egg noodles?
Then two bowls of zhajiang noodles.

title: 口味 Taste
twist: Preferences: spice and takeaway. 不然 becomes the default branch.

vip.name: Tom (exchange student)
vip.situation: Tom can't eat spicy food and wants to take it back to the dorm.

turns.says: 请问，我要一碗酸辣粉，不要辣。
turns.en: Excuse me, one hot-and-sour noodles, not spicy.

turns.modelEn: OK, I'll pack it for you.

levels.title: 还是 Here or to go?

title: 付钱 Paying
twist: Customers pay by 扫码 or 现金. Bigger orders, bigger numbers.

vip.name: 张经理 (Manager Zhang)
vip.situation: A manager orders lunch for the office and pays in cash.

turns.says: 我要十个包子，五瓶可乐。一共多少钱？
turns.en: Ten baozi and five colas. How much in total?

turns.modelEn: OK, I'll pack it for you.

title: 算了 Change of mind
twist: Customers change their minds and ask for one more. Day 1–4 patterns return.

vip.name: 小陈 (Xiao Chen, food blogger)
vip.situation: A food blogger keeps changing the order while filming.

turns.says: 我要一碗牛肉面，算了，我要两碗炸酱面，微辣。
turns.en: One beef noodles… forget it, two zhajiang noodles, mildly spicy.

title: 水果店 Fruit shop
twist: A new shop! Fruit is sold by the 斤 (jīn, half a kilo), a watermelon by the 个. Your noodle rules for ordering and paying work here too, but in a shop you 给 (give) instead of 做 (cook). Start a new script.

vip.name: 李奶奶 (Grandma Li)
vip.situation: A regular who wants to talk to you, not the robot.

title: 讲价 Bargaining
twist: Customers haggle. Stay friendly: it is already cheap, the price stays. And 西瓜 is sold out today, so check 有 before you give.

vip.name: 张经理 (Manager Zhang)
vip.situation: A regular who wants to talk to you, not the robot.

levels.title: 便宜一点吧 A bit cheaper, please.

title: 尝一下 Try it

levels.title: 可以尝一下吗 Can I try one?
有袋子吗 Do you have a bag?
